conclusion: AMB-02 changes COORDINATES, not the SPAN. Under both readings the published triple has rank 3 and therefore spans all of Q10, so the union of both readings still has rank 3. The pure-N4125 basis spans the same Q10 under either reading. The pure-N basis therefore REMOVES dependence on the ambiguity for any span-level statement, and gives an unconditional replacement for the ambiguity-sensitive published members. It does NOT resolve which reading the source intends; that needs the source notation.
